name: Ellsworth AFB
description: Home of the 28th Bomb Wing. Ellsworth AFB operates B-1B Lancer conventional bomber missions and supports global strike operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Liberty Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Only 24/7 gate. Visitor Control Center located here. Use for RV/FamCamp access.
gates.address: 1940 EP Howe Drive, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

gates.name: Bismarck Gate (Commercial)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Weekday commuter and commercial gate near I-90.

gates.name: Patriot Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Weekday commuter gate near I-90. Restricted to authorized personnel without VCC pass.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Liberty Gate)
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Phone: 605-385-2895.

resources.name: Raider Café (Dining Facility)
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting the 28th Bomb Wing with full meal service.

resources.name: Ellsworth Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Ellsworth Main Exchange with food court, barber, beauty shop, optical, GNC, and shoppette.
resources.address: 2649 Lemay St, Bldg 1650, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: Sentinel Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: Bellamy Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with weights, cardio, group exercise, indoor track, racquetball, basketball, steam rooms, sauna, and 24/7 access for registered CAC holders.
resources.hours: 24/7 for registered users; staffed hours vary
resources.address: 2370 Risner Drive, Bldg 7709, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: Pine Tree Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: 1000 Ellsworth Street, Suite 1500, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: 28th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.
resources.address: 2570 George Drive, Bldg 4610, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: Bandit Lanes Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling center with snack bar and league play.

resources.name: Prairie Ridge Golf Course
resources.description: On-base golf course with pro shop.
resources.address: Prairie Ridge Golf Course, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: 28th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1630; closed third Wed afternoon for training

events.title: Trunk or Treat Vehicle Sign-Up
events.description: Date of event: 24 October | 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM Join us if you dare on 24 October in our annual Trunk or Treat at Dakota’s parking lot. Register today to decorate your vehicle and hand out candy to all the little ghouls, ghosts, and goblins (and all the princesses and super heroes too!) on 24 October. All groups welcome Candy will be provided! If you would like to decorate a vehicle, please register on Eventbrite. https://eafbtrunkortreatcandyhandout2026.eventbrite.com Please register by 21 October. For more information, please contact FSS Marketing at 605-385-1533

events.title: Pheasant Hunt
events.description: 31 October 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM at Dakota Honey Hole Hunt includes: guides dogs shooting practice game packaging meal refreshments Transportation is NOT provided. Hunters must have a South Dakota small game license, hunt safe card, shotgun, and shells. $300 per person Open to all Active Duty, DoD Civilians, and base personnel. First EIGHT sign ups get $50 off! For more information and to register, please contact Outdoor Rec at 605-385-2997.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Pine Tree Inn (605-385-2844) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (605-385-2569) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 28 FSS, M&FRC, and official Ellsworth sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
